start: More, a gym with a year of members, fees and check-ins on record

user_sees: Page titled "Your growth" with "Is your gym growing? Month by month, before and since MettleUp."
A summary that starts "Since you started MettleUp in <month>, compared with the months before:" with lines such as "Money collected: up 18% a month"
The line "Started on MettleUp: <day>. These numbers show what changed since you started, not why."
must_not: A summary line with only one side of the comparison
A cancelled receipt counted in Money collected

user_sees: "Money collected", "Active members", "New members", "Renewal rate", "Members lost", "Visits per member", each with "Before MettleUp" and "Since MettleUp"
A month whose 15 renewal days are not over shows "–" for Renewal rate and Members lost
must_not: A "100%" renewal rate made from the few plans decided so far
This month so far counted as a full month in an average

user_sees: A file named <gym>-growth-<today>.csv is saved
Toast "Downloaded 12 months." (or "Downloaded 1 month.")
must_not: A file that shows different figures from the page
Hindi or rupee letters shown as boxes in Excel

start: What is new list in the panel, the "Your growth" entry

user_sees: The same "Your growth" page as from More
must_not: A blank page or the Today screen

user_sees: A page titled "Share this report" with "One page to print, or to save as a PDF and send."
The button "Print or save as PDF" and a way back
must_not: Figures on the print page that differ from the main page

user_sees: The browser print window with the report on one page
must_not: Menus or buttons printed on the page
The report cut off at the right edge

start: A gym that started on MettleUp this month, with no old records

user_sees: "You started MettleUp in <month>."
"Your first comparison shows after <day>, once you have 2 full months on MettleUp."
A card "To compare with before MettleUp, add your old records" with the button "Add old records"
"The charts start once your gym has two months on record. This month so far is below."
must_not: Six empty charts
NaN, Infinity or "0%" shown as a change
An error screen

user_sees: The import screen for an Excel or CSV file
must_not: A dead button

start: Your growth, first shown without old records (first months against latest months)

user_sees: "Your latest 3 months on MettleUp, compared with your first 3 months:" and sides named "First months" and "Latest months"
must_not: The words "Before MettleUp" when no month before the start is on record

steps.action: Add old member and fee records through "Add old records", then open "Your growth" again
user_sees: The summary changes to "Since you started MettleUp in <month>, compared with the months before:"
The card "To compare with before MettleUp, add your old records" is gone once 2 months before the start are on record
must_not: The old comparison still shown after the import
Old months counted as "Since MettleUp"

steps.action: Cancel a receipt of last month in Money, then open "Your growth" again
user_sees: Money collected for last month is lower by that receipt
must_not: The cancelled money still inside the month total

start: A second login on the same gym that is front desk (staff), to check what the owner page gives away

user_sees: No "Your growth" line in the list
must_not: The staff login seeing the gym money month by month

steps.action: Type the address of the page (/growth) by hand
user_sees: The owner-only screen with the button "Back to Today"
must_not: Any month figure, chart or the download button shown to staff
